_comment: Exact-version, time-limited exception after MCP import reachability review; see SECURITY-RELEASE.md.

advisories.reason: Accepted by the owner (dontuh3) on 2026-10-08 as a dated bridge, not a fix. decode-uri-component 0.2.2 arrives only through x402/paywall's browser-wallet tree (x402 -> wagmi -> WalletConnect -> query-string); this MCP signs with a local viem account and nothing here or in x402-fetch imports x402/paywall. On 2026-10-08 (commit 5dbea77) module tracing of a real paid tool call (initialization, signing, payment) loaded none of that tree, from both the repository lockfile and a consumer install of the packed tarball; a positive control did. tests/dependency-guard.test.js now fails if it ever loads. Patched 0.5.0 is ESM-only and incompatible with its CommonJS consumer, so no override. Remediation: migrate to the modular @x402 v2 packages, which do not depend on wagmi. Re-review on any wallet, import or dependency change, and by the reviewBy date.
